mechanism: Timestamped corporate disclosures can define ex-ante event grammars whose post-publication response is evaluated only after the public timestamp.

qualification_questions.q1_timestamp_dictionary: Does the official CVM metadata dictionary explicitly document a row-level delivery/receipt/public-availability date and time field usable without inference?
qualification_questions.q2_timestamp_physical: Does the physical 2026 IPE file contain that documented field with parseable values on event-document rows?
qualification_questions.q3_issuer_identity: Does the physical file expose a stable issuer identity key sufficient to join to an independently qualified issuer-to-B3 mapping later?
qualification_questions.q4_event_category: Does the file expose document category/type fields sufficient to freeze an event class without reading market outcomes?
